description: Continental US flights · Free to try

01.headline: Know how bumpy before you board
01.primary: Turbulence is weather, and weather can be forecast. BumpCast shows when the bumps will come on your exact flight, how strong they'll be and when they'll end. Built for nervous flyers.

02.headline: A countdown to every bump
02.primary: BumpCast counts down to each bumpy stretch on your Lock Screen, so nothing takes you by surprise. The forecast is saved before takeoff, so it works in airplane mode.

03.headline: See the bumps before you board
03.primary: Flying for Thanksgiving? Add your flight to BumpCast now. 48 hours before takeoff you'll see when the bumps will come, how strong they'll be and when they'll end, in plain words.

04.headline: Flight tracking for nervous flyers
04.primary: Live status, gates and delays, plus a minute-by-minute turbulence forecast for your exact flight. Flight tracking, built for nervous flyers.

05.headline: Delayed? You'll know first
05.primary: If your flight is delayed, BumpCast tells you, and your turbulence forecast moves with the new departure time. One app for the flight and the bumps.

06.headline: Add your flight in seconds
06.primary: Thanksgiving travel, minus the guesswork. Type your flight number and BumpCast tracks delays and gates, and forecasts the turbulence on your exact flight.

07.headline: Every bump, minute by minute
07.primary: BumpCast lays out your flight minute by minute: when the bumps start, how strong they'll be and when it's smooth again. For your exact flight, 48 hours out.

08.headline: Will my flight be bumpy?
08.primary: Will my flight be bumpy? Type your flight number into BumpCast and it tells you in plain words: when the bumps come, how strong they'll be and how long they last.

09.headline: Turbulence is weather
09.primary: The most common bumps at cruise come from fast winds next to slower air. That's weather, and BumpCast forecasts it for your exact flight, 48 hours before takeoff.

10.headline: See where the bumps are
10.primary: See the bumpy patches along your route by altitude, with live reports from pilots in the air. BumpCast shows where the bumps are and when you'll reach them.

11.headline: Breathe through the bumpy bits
11.primary: When BumpCast says light chop is 12 minutes away, you can breathe through it with a guided exercise timed to the bumpy stretch. Built for nervous flyers.

12.headline: Updates that say what changed
12.primary: Your forecast updates from 48 hours out until it's confirmed on the day, and every update says what changed. Smoother over Colorado? You'll know.

13.headline: Tracked from takeoff to landing
13.primary: From the gate to landing, BumpCast tracks your flight and counts down to each bumpy stretch on your Lock Screen, even in airplane mode.

14.headline: Find your flight in seconds
14.primary: Type a flight number or pick from the day's nonstops. BumpCast finds it in seconds, then tracks status and gates and forecasts the turbulence.

15.headline: The tracker that forecasts the bumps
15.primary: Status, gates and delays, like any flight tracker. Plus a turbulence forecast for your exact flight, in plain words.

16.headline: Built for nervous flyers
16.primary: BumpCast is built for nervous flyers. It shows where the bumps are on your route, when they'll come and how strong they'll be, with guided breathing for each one.

17.headline: Turbulence, in plain words
17.primary: BumpCast explains each bumpy stretch on your flight in plain words: how strong it is, how long it lasts and why it happens. Built for nervous flyers.

18.headline: Gets sharper as you get closer
18.primary: Your BumpCast forecast starts 48 hours before takeoff and gets sharper as your flight gets closer, until it's confirmed on the day. Every update says what changed.

19.headline: See how right we were
19.primary: After you land, BumpCast shows what it forecast for your flight, and you can say how it felt. Every answer helps make the forecasts more accurate. Built for nervous flyers.

20.headline: Know when it's smooth again
20.primary: BumpCast counts down to each bumpy stretch on your Lock Screen and tells you how long it lasts, so you know when it's smooth again. Built for nervous flyers.

21.headline: The next bump, at a glance
21.primary: BumpCast keeps a countdown to the next bumpy stretch in the Dynamic Island and on your Lock Screen. The forecast is saved before takeoff, so it keeps counting in airplane mode.

22.headline: Keeps counting in airplane mode
22.primary: Your BumpCast forecast is saved before takeoff, so the countdown to every bumpy stretch keeps going in airplane mode. Minute by minute, from takeoff to landing.
